job.title: Contracts Administrator
job.description:
Contract Administrator / Project Manager - Civil Infrastructure
  • Rate: $80 per hour + super
  • Start date: September 2026
  • Contract: 12 Months
  • Working arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: Western Sydney
About the Role
 
We are seeking an experienced Contract Administrator / Project Manager to support the delivery of a diverse portfolio of civil infrastructure and community projects.
 
You will administer construction and professional-services contracts while coordinating projects from planning through to completion. Projects range in value from approximately $10,000 to $70 million and include roads, drainage, bridges, buildings and recreational spaces.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Administer AS2124 and AS4000 contracts across civil infrastructure projects.
  • Prepare contract documentation, correspondence, notices and project records.
  • Assess and process claims, variations, extension-of-time requests and payments.
  • Monitor contractual obligations, performance, risks and emerging disputes.
  • Coordinate projects to achieve agreed budgets, deadlines and quality standards.
  • Manage procurement, capital expenditure, resource allocation and progress reporting.
  • Work closely with internal teams, contractors, consultants and service providers.
  • Participate in contractor meetings and undertake site inspections when required.
  • Identify delivery risks and provide advice to project and program leadership.
  • Improve contract administration systems, documentation and reporting processes.
About You
You will bring:
  • At least eight years' relevant experience in contract administration, project coordination or civil infrastructure delivery.
  • Strong experience administering AS2124 and AS4000 contracts.
  • Experience with civil works, construction services and professional consulting contracts.
  • Knowledge of roads, drainage, utilities, buildings or recreational infrastructure.
  • Experience delivering complex, long-term projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong project management, commercial, negotiation and risk-management capabilities.
  • Excellent written communication, organisation and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project.
  • A qualification in construction, civil engineering, project management or a related discipline.
  • A valid White Card and current Class C driver's licence.
Experience within local government and qualifications in contract administration or CPEng membership will be highly regarded.

job.title: Assistant Support officer x2 - 6 month contracts
job.description:
We are looking for 2 Admin Support officers to work for an intial 6 months. This is based in Nowra correctional facility. This role is office/ site based only.

You will be rostered to work any five (5) days within a seven (7) day operational cycle, including rotational weekend coverage to meet business requirements.
This will help ensure business continuity, as the Administration Support Officer plays a critical role in managing the switchboard, processing inmates incoming and outgoing mail, and providing essential administrative support across general administration and records management functions.

If you have the skills above and pass a police check and can work the hours then apply now.

job.title: Business Analyst
job.description:
Business Analyst
Location: Parramatta 
Rate: $90-$125.70/hr + Super
Hybrid: 3 days in office
Start: ASAP
End Date: 31st December (possible extensions)
 
Business Analyst
 
About the Role
 
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support the delivery of digital solutions within a complex business environment. You will work closely with stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs, define requirements and translate them into clear, actionable outcomes.
 
This role will suit a Business Analyst who is comfortable working across both business and technology teams and can manage competing priorities while ensuring solutions remain aligned with business objectives.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Facilitate workshops and requirements gathering sessions with key stakeholders.
  • Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Gather, analyse and document functional and technical requirements.
  • Develop clear user stories and contribute to backlog management.
  • Translate complex business needs into requirements that technical teams can deliver against.
  • Maintain traceability between business requirements and delivered solutions.
  • Support testing and validation activities to ensure solutions meet requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with stakeholders, delivery teams and technical specialists.
  • Help ensure technology solutions align with broader business strategies and objectives.
About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • 4+ years' experience working as a Business Analyst or in a related role.
  • Proven experience in business analysis within digital delivery environments.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and facilitation skills.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including user stories and backlog management.
  • An understanding of relational database and client-server concepts.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex requirements and competing priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • The ability to confidently translate business requirements into clear technical requirements for delivery teams.
What You'll Bring
 
You will be a proactive and collaborative Business Analyst who can operate comfortably between business stakeholders and technical teams. You will bring strong judgement, attention to detail and the ability to understand complex business problems and develop practical solutions.
The role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful digital delivery initiatives while collaborating with a range of stakeholders and delivery specialists.
The role's core focus is supporting digital solution delivery through business analysis, requirements definition and collaboration between stakeholders and technical teams.
